notes.title: REAVE | Iron Shadows Playtest is LIVE!
notes.content:
REAVE | Playtest 10: Iron Shadows is LIVE 🎉
Join the Discord to get access -> Reave Discord  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45652815/2755923e0965630933808e2495ba76d3d8912f01.gif

The playtest runs from September 18th to September 30th.

❗ Please update your game to the latest version before playing!

What’s New in This Playtest:

• 🏅 Claim your legend – unlock 30+ titles with the new Names & Title System  
• 🥷 Strike from the shadows – equip the all-new Rogue Armor Set, the first Light Armor for agile fighters  
• 🏰 Explore new territory – discover the atmospheric Iron Keep, the final of the four new spawn areas  
• ⚔️ Command the Hall – venture into the re-imagined Command Hall, an upgraded take on the old Guard’s Lair  
• 🎥 Capture the action – record your raids and antics with the new LIV Camera, with flexible FOVs, resolutions and aspect ratios  
• ⚖️ Balance & loot updates – rarity-based stamina scaling, merchant pricing tweaks and rebalanced weapon & armor stats

🏆 Community Bounty  
Summon and defeat a boss while recording your run—use any software or the new LIV Camera—and your clip could be featured in the next YouTube Devlog!

📰 Full patch notes will be posted on the official wiki: https://reave.wiki.gg/wiki/September_2025_Changelist
Reave Wiki

Join the Discord to playtest, chat with the devs, and help shape the future of REAVE!
